name: A Place for us

description.content: While healing another Survivor, you both gain [Elusive].
Whenever you finish healing the Obsession, you both gain [Elusive] for [30s].
When the trial starts, you are less likely to be the Obsession.

quote: "I understand computers... systems. Problems. But this... I wonder if I'll ever understand." -Kwon Tae-Young
